claim: The file supports three prototype workflows: property prediction, structure generation, and autonomous optimization.
Best tabular graph-descriptor property model is Ridge with CV MAE 0.599.
Top generated lattice candidate has a=5.6789, b=5.3456, desirability=0.696.
Optimization workflow recommends next high-UCB condition near 425.0 C and 25.5 min.
Exact CGCNN or multimodal image/spectra/text fusion was not possible because the dataset lacks species-resolved structures, image files, spectra, and literature text records.
